messages.subject: Re: rapache 1.2.3 ubuntu builds
messages.body_plain:
I'm doing several projects now, I manage the versions though launchpad repositories. All opencpu and ohmage "production" repositories are on 2.15.1. The rapache and rapparmor repos have upgraded to 3.0.0.

I've gone back and forth between c2d4u. It has only 25% of all packages, and they can only target one version of R. Because packages are not compatible anymore between 2.15 and 3.0 it might be better to build them yourself at this point.

Also I am considering starting my own repo on github for cran packages that specify explicit dependency versions <http://arxiv.org/abs/1303.2140>, the same way as julia manages packages: https://github.com/JuliaLang/METADATA.jl.

messages.subject: rApache and Persistent data
messages.body_plain:
I'm developing a web-based application with rApache, RJSONIO and Dojo.  So far so good.  I'm using r scripts that receive POST data and return JSON.  I've decided to "keep it all on one page" and there are no page transitions.  Dojo works nicely for that.

An area that I think could use a bit more elegance, is how persistent data is handled. At the moment, each script parses POST data for user/sessionid information, loads in rData files, performs the functions needed in the script and then saves the rData files, when they change. Is there a way to make this more transparent?  Sometimes I run into errors and the data is not saved when it would be nice if it was.

Any thoughts or suggestions on what would be the best way to handle persistent data with rApache or is basically the technique I'm using the best way?  Databases can be used but they too must be called explicitly.  As far as I know, there is no way to keep persistent data without some explicit method in R.

(I was thinking it might be a nice feature to have "pre" and "post" file handers or something like that, where scripts are executed before (pre) and after (post) any script that runs.  These could be used to load and save env data needed for the app.)
